title: liparis labiata
intro: Liparis labiata, commonly known as the Chinese liparis or fishbelly orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include improving circulation, reducing inflammation, and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Liparis labiata include acting as a vasodilator, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful for treating conditions such as hypertension, bronchitis, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Liparis labiata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
